name: literature: the Galaxy NAR papers land as PDFs
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy with literature tools (usegalaxy.eu); skipped on a Galaxy without the Europe PMC route it requires. The request is a user's own, verbatim. Galaxy has to hold the result: a PDF of each of the six Galaxy update papers in Nucleic Acids Research (2016 to 2026), named by any of its PMCID, PMID, DOI suffix or OpenAlex id, so a Europe PMC download, an OpenAlex download and a direct upload all count. The same papers buried in thousands of free-text hits, or a different paper's citing works, do not. Europe PMC serves all six PDFs; their OpenAlex open-access links point at the publisher, which refuses the download.
inputs: I would like to search for all Galaxy NAR papers. Can you search for a tool that can do that and download me the PDF?
